scope: Two existing lobby leaderboards, their twenty authored rows and two hidden RowTemplate objects.
pixelPolicy: All eight PNGs staged as exact byte copies. No editing, resizing, cropping or re-encoding of source images.

avatarBorder.application: Overlay live Avatar ImageLabel with a child ImageLabel; preserve original Avatar.Image and ScaleType.

fitPolicy: Every imported ImageLabel uses ScaleType.Fit. Only newly added artwork fills its existing parent bounds.
existingLayout: Positions, sizes, anchor points, names, text values, visibility and live Avatar.Image on existing objects remain authored.
textPolicy: Existing TextLabels retain editable text, native fonts and authored sizing. Light fill plus contextual dark navy UIStroke at ScaledSize thickness 0.085; legacy glyph stroke and duplicate frame strokes disabled.
layering: Board artwork below Header/Body. Row artwork below RankBadge/Avatar. Rank artwork below Rank text. Transparent avatar-border overlay above avatar image. Text above all backgrounds.
knownLimits: Fitted image ratios differ slightly from native bounds, leaving subpixel letterboxing rather than stretching supplied artwork.
The physical board Part colors and geometry remain unchanged; their authored SurfaceGui receives the skin.
Header star uses uploaded Attachments/icon-xp-star.png when supplied, otherwise retains its native glyph.
No Studio installation or Play testing performed by this script-authoring subtask.
